## VDown Desktop, Mobile & CLI Media Downloader

A versatile media downloader available as a **Windows standalone desktop app**, a **native Android app**, and a **Python CLI**.

### 🌟 Key Highlights
- 🖥️ **Windows Desktop GUI Application**: Modern standalone application with Dark/AMOLED theme, format selectors, live download speed, ETA countdown, and library history.
- 🦊 **Automatic Firefox & Browser Cookie Detection**: Automatically extracts session cookies from Mozilla Firefox, Chrome, Brave, and Edge to bypass anti-bot verification and download login-protected/age-gated media.
- 📱 **Native Android Companion App**: Full Material Design 3 app featuring dark/AMOLED theme, smooth bottom navigation, in-app media player, and gallery integration.
- ⚡ **Facebook Videos & Reels Engine**: Direct extraction of HD/SD CDN streams from Facebook reels, videos, and mobile `/share/r/` & `/share/v/` links without requiring login.
- 🔗 **Android System Share Sheet**: Share any video or Reel directly from Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, or web browsers to VDown for instant one-tap downloading.
- 🎵 **Studio-Quality Audio Extraction**: 320 kbps MP3, Lossless FLAC, M4A, and WAV extraction.
- 🎬 **TikTok Watermark-Free Engine**: Clean MP4 video downloads and HD photo slideshows.

### 📥 Downloads
- **Windows Standalone App**: Download [**vdown.exe**](https://github.com/dularacharith/vdown/releases/latest/download/vdown.exe) (double-click to run, no installation or Python required).
- **Android Mobile App**: Download [**vdown.apk**](https://github.com/dularacharith/vdown/releases/latest/download/vdown.apk) to install on your mobile device.

---
### 💻 Source & Script Installation
```bash
git clone https://github.com/dularacharith/vdown.git
cd vdown
./install.sh   # Linux / macOS
install.bat    # Windows
```
